captions.detailed: This is a garage floor pump featuring a vertical red cylindrical barrel mounted on a wide, black rectangular foot base. A silver metallic piston rod extends upwards from the barrel, terminating in a black T-handle. On the side of the barrel, there is a black hose clip mechanism, and near the base, a circular analog pressure gauge with a white face and a yellow needle is attached. The T-handle and its attached piston rod slide up and down along the vertical axis, the gauge needle rotates on its central pivot, and a black sleeve grip on one side of the crossbar rotates around its longitudinal axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a garage floor pump with a red main barrel, a black rectangular base, a silver piston rod, and a T-handle. Incorporate a circular pressure gauge with a rotatable needle near the base, a side hose clip, and a rotatable sleeve grip on the handle, ensuring proper prismatic and revolute articulations.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first building a fixed base assembly containing a thin rectangular box for the footplate, a red cylinder for the pump barrel, a cylindrical pressure gauge body with a white face plate, and a side hose clip modeled with small boxes and cylinders. The moving piston rod is created as a silver cylinder, which is capped with a black T-handle crossbar. A revolute needle is modeled as a small wedge/cylinder on the gauge face, and a continuous rotating sleeve is added as a cylinder coaxial with one side of the T-handle. Prismatic, revolute, and continuous joints are defined to connect the piston rod, needle, and sleeve to their respective parents.
